subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Shahidullah Kaiser was both a novelist and a writer. He was also a journalist. He took his Bachelor's degree from Presidency College, Kolkata. He was active in politics and cultural movements from his student life. He took part in Language Movement and was arrested several times for this reason. He did a lot for the country. He also participated in the Liberation War. He was caught rounded up by the Pakistan Army and its local collaboratiors on 14 December, 1971 and never came back.
